name: Diffusion Prior Guidance for Pseudo Views
aliases: 3D Gaussian Splatting with Diffusion Prior Regularization
definition: Regularization step during 3DGS training that uses a fine-tuned diffusion model to generate guidance images for randomly sampled pseudo views.
summary: Diffusion Prior Guidance for Pseudo Views is a 3D Gaussian Splatting training method that uses a diffusion model to regularize parameters via pseudo-views, avoiding SfM bias by relying solely on LiDAR data.
